newsitem.title: ESTONIA: INDEX EASES, SELLING PRESSURE EXPECTED.
newsitem.headline: INDEX EASES, SELLING PRESSURE EXPECTED.

text.p: * Total trade at 74.9 million kroons vs 156.7 million
kroons.
* Index 0.36 percent lower to 349.97.
* 26 stocks traded: 15 down, 9 up, 2 steady.
* Forekspank most active to gain 7.5 kroons to 230
kroons in trade of 20.4 million kroons.
* Hoiupank adds 3.5 kroons to close at 207.50
kroons on turnover of 16.4 million kroons.
* Hansapank turns over 13.5 million kroons to lose
2.50 kroons to 192.50 kroons.
* On the free market, Norma turns over 2.1 million
kroons to close 0.50 kroons higher at 90 kroons.
(A complete report follows)
(See the stock exchange web site: http://www.tse.ee/stat/)
Most shares eased slightly on Monday by the close although Forekspank and Hoiupank bucked the trend to make more gains.
Dealers said the stock exchange, which has seen almost two weeks of record highs, could suffer a bout of selling Tuesday.
Total trade on the main list was 71.1 million kroons with the Talse 0.36 percent lower to close at 349.97.
"Prices are very high now and we expect sellers to be more active tomorrow, they started to move today," one trader said.
With low liquidity driving prices in morning trade, both Forekspank and Hoiupank made strong gains.
Forekspank was the most active stock with 20 million kroons traded to close 7.50 kroons higher on 230.00.
Hoiupank gained 3.50 kroons to close on 207.50 kroons after turning over 16.4 million kroons.
On the free market trade was more subdued with only 3.8 million kroons traded.
Norma, an automotive safety belt manufacturer, was the most active to gain slightly on trade worth 2.1 million kroons.
Norma was 0.50 kroons higher to close on 90 kroons a rsie of 0.50 kroons.
-- David Mardiste, Tallinn newsroom, +372 620 9202, reuters@reuters.ee
